title: Apple in talks to pay publishers to provide Siri with current news: report | TechCrunch
summary: Apple is in talks to pay publishers to use their content to power the upcoming Siri AI, according to a new report from The Wall Street Journal . Apple has considered a nine-figure budget for the payments, the report says.
